purpose: Teach: 人様/見合っ/ヶ国/すぐさま/助長/覆っ/ほかなら/乗せる

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、人様のお家を覗いてはいけないわ
lines.en: Sho, you can't go peeking into other people's homes.
lines.style: Gentle but clear boundary-setting. Warm corrective tone, not stern. Speaks as an older sister who needs him to understand, not obey. Steady eye contact, slight lean forward.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと目を見合って笑ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I looked at each other and laughed!
lines.style: Bright, immediate excitement. Quick tempo on the first two words. Opens wide on 'laughed' — the joy tumbles out unguarded. Pure delight at the shared moment.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが世界二十ヶ国近くを回られたって聞いたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad has traveled to nearly twenty countries, hasn't he?
lines.style: Thoughtful, gentle. Pause before speaking — she's processing what this story means. Warm curiosity underlying the observation. Slow, measured delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんがすぐさま駆けつけて下さったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad came running right away to help me!
lines.style: Urgent warmth. Quick attack on the first phrase. The middle part rushes forward with gratitude and amazement. Voice brightens on 'help' — pride and relief mixed together.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、間違った行動を助長しないようにね
lines.en: Sho, we shouldn't encourage behavior that's not quite right.
lines.style: Gentle redirection, not scolding. Thoughtful pause at the opening. Uses 'we' — drawing him in rather than lecturing down. Quiet conviction underneath the softness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと毛布で頭を覆ってかくれんぼしたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad put me on his bike and we rode together!
lines.style: Unbridled happiness. Quick, breathless delivery. Voice rises slightly with each new detail. Ending note climbs — he's still riding that high, wanting her to feel it too.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんはほかならぬ翔くんの味方よ
lines.en: Sho, you know I'm on your side, always.
lines.style: Soft opening, like she's telling him something true and important. Slow, deliberate pace. Slight emphasis on 'always' — a quiet promise. Warm and steady as bedrock.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんが自転車に乗せるって仰ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad said he'd take me on his bicycle again!
lines.style: Breathless wonder mixed with certainty. Quick, eager tempo. Rises on 'again' — the word carries the promise forward into the future he's already seeing. Small, genuine laugh in the voice.
